description: Upcoming events by topic and city, or from Luma / Eventbrite / Meetup links (or any page with schema.org events): name, dates, venue with address and coordinates, organiser, hosts, ticket prices, free/sold-out and attendee count, in one format. Use for event prospecting, sponsorships and community research. Runs the Apify Actor tacps126/events-scraper on your Apify account (about $0.001 per event; spend per call is capped at $0.5).

extra_input.description: Advanced: extra Actor input fields, merged over the defaults.

include_details.description: Open each event for organiser, tickets and full description. Off = faster.

location.description: City in plain words (e.g. "London", "Bengaluru") or "online". Luma searches within a city.

max_items.description: Maximum results to return (default 30, max 500). Cost scales with this.

sources.description: Sites searched for `searches` (default all three). Meetup knows about 70 big cities by name; others as "City, CC" (e.g. "Lyon, FR").

urls.description: Luma city/category/calendar/event links, Eventbrite searches or events, Meetup search or group links, or any events page.

name: find_events

count.description: Number of records the Actor returned.

items.description: The records. Long text fields are shortened to 600 characters.

shown.description: Number of records included in `items` (can be lower than count when the result is long).

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced the result.

truncated.description: True when records were left out to keep the result short; ask for fewer items.

title: Find upcoming events (Luma, Eventbrite, Meetup)
